scope: Miao Chapter 12 (pp. 385-410): GMM (Assumptions 12.1.1-12.1.10, consistency Theorem 12.1.1 with a uniform law of large numbers from Birkhoff's theorem, asymptotic normality Theorem 12.1.2, efficient weighting, the J statistic algebra, HAC), maximum likelihood (information matrix equality, Cramer-Rao, Example 12.2.1), simulated method of moments, simulated ML, indirect inference (Examples 12.3.1-12.3.3), and Exercises 1-4.
